pages.text: The Reactor, the beating heart of thermal power.$(br)Enclose a sealed box of side 5 or 7 with reactor casings, put the controller and ports on the walls, and inside place 1 reactor core, fuel rods (≤10), and cooling components (≤20).$(br)Feed in fuel cells to start burning — 400-700℃ gives the best output. Temperature control is a craft.

Fuel rods unlock fuel slots (up to 10); cooling components hold heat sinks and only work when adjacent to a fuel rod.$(br2)$(2,4)Life-saving warning$(0): above 850℃ output drops; once heat hits 1000℃ it explodes after 10 seconds and leaks a waste zone! Max your heat sinks and keep waste handling ready — don't gamble with your base.
